data: ALTER TABLE test_case ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS search_vector TSVECTOR NULL
ALTER TABLE test_suite ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS search_vector TSVECTOR NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION build_test_case_search_vector(p_title TEXT, p_short_name TEXT, p_text TEXT, p_preconditions TEXT, p_steps TEXT, p_expected_results TEXT, p_postconditions TEXT, p_external_id TEXT, p_link TEXT) RETURNS TSVECTOR LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$ BEGIN RETURN setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_title, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_short_name, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_text, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_preconditions, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_steps, '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_expected_results, '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_postconditions, '')), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_external_id, '')), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_link, '')), 'D'); EXCEPTION WHEN program_limit_exceeded THEN RETURN setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_title, ''), 8192)), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_short_name, ''), 8192)), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_text, ''), 8192)), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_preconditions, ''), 8192)), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_steps, ''), 8192)), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_expected_results, ''), 8192)), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_postconditions, ''), 8192)), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_external_id, ''), 8192)), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_link, ''), 8192)), 'D'); END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_test_case_search_vector() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.search_vector := build_test_case_search_vector(NEW.title, NEW.short_name, NEW.text, NEW.preconditions, NEW.steps, NEW.expected_results, NEW.postconditions, NEW.external_id, NEW.link); RETURN NEW; END $$
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_test_case_search_vector ON test_case

CREATE TRIGGER trg_test_case_search_vector BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF title, short_name, text, preconditions, steps, expected_results, postconditions, external_id, link ON test_case FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_test_case_search_vector()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION build_test_suite_search_vector(p_name TEXT, p_description TEXT) RETURNS TSVECTOR LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$ BEGIN RETURN setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_name, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_description, '')), 'B'); EXCEPTION WHEN program_limit_exceeded THEN RETURN setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_name, ''), 8192)), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(p_description, ''), 8192)), 'B'); END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_test_suite_search_vector() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.search_vector := build_test_suite_search_vector(NEW.name, NEW.description); RETURN NEW; END $$
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_test_suite_search_vector ON test_suite
CREATE TRIGGER trg_test_suite_search_vector BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF name, description ON test_suite FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_test_suite_search_vector()
